Title: Show HN: Loböle, open-source parametric CAD that AI agents can drive
Article title: GitHub - eliasaronson/lobole: Parametric 3D CAD with assemblies, drawings, FEM and CAM, scriptable from Python and agents over MCP. · GitHub
Description: Parametric 3D CAD with assemblies, drawings, FEM and CAM, scriptable from Python and agents over MCP. - eliasaronson/lobole
HN text: I could never get used to FreeCAD, so I built my own. It turns out Claude is really good at using it. Loböle is a parametric B-Rep CAD built on OpenCASCADE and Vulkan, with sketches, assemblies, drawings, FEM and CAM. The GUI, Python scripts and AI agents all go through the same commands, so an agent can do anything you can in the GUI. The engine, watch and bicycle in the README were each built by Claude writing a script against it.

articles.title: Took apart Claude Code, then turned it into a free course on harness engineering
articles.title_ja: Took apart Claude Code, then turned it into a free course on harness engineering
articles.summary_ja:
Title: Took apart Claude Code, then turned it into a free course on harness engineering
HN text: The fastest way to learn harness engineering? Build Claude Code from scratch. Why harness engineering? LangChain kept the same model and changed only the harness. Their coding agent went from 53% to 67% on Terminal-Bench, a top coding-agent benchmark. From outside the top 30 to the top 5. Same model. Better harness. Over the past few months, I've taken apart Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi to see how they work under the hood. And you don't need to ship a coding agent for this to pay off. The same foundations power any agent, in e-commerce, finance, or sales. On top of that, people are increasingly realizing they need to build their own harness instead of relying on Claude Code or Codex. Ramp scaling its operations with a custom harness is a perfect example. So I turned what I learned into an in…
